kind.description: What this issue actually is. Severity only carries meaning for bug_report.

severity.description: Proposed severity, per the official classification in the system prompt.

confidence.description: How sure you are. 'low' routes the item to the sheriff's attention list.

rationale.description: One sentence naming the criterion that decided the severity.

category.description: Top-level area, matching the repository's category labels.

component.description: Back-office section concerned, or 'none' when it does not apply.

suggested_status.description: What the sheriff should do next with this issue.

security_suspicion.description: True whenever a security reading is plausible, even if severity is lower.

looks_like_regression.description: True when the report says the behaviour worked in an earlier version and broke in a later one.

duplicate_candidates.description: Issue numbers taken ONLY from the candidate list supplied in the user message.

needs_human_now.description: True when the sheriff should look this week rather than in the normal queue.

attention.description: How urgently the sheriff needs to touch this PR.

confidence.description: How sure you are, given the timeline is readable.

rationale.description: One sentence naming the concrete fact that decided the attention level.

waiting_on.description: Who the ball is actually with, read from the timeline rather than the labels.

target_branch_looks_wrong.description: True when the stated type contradicts the base branch under the upward-merge rules.

is_community_pr_unanswered.description: True when a non-maintainer opened it and no maintainer has responded.

metadata_incomplete.description: True when a substantive template row is missing or left as a placeholder.
